## Verification & Testing
Before submitting this PR, please complete the following verification checklist:

### Automated Checks
- [ ] All unit tests pass (`npm run test`)
- [ ] Chrome build compiles successfully (`npm run build:chrome`)
- [ ] Firefox build compiles successfully (`npm run build:firefox`)

### Manual Verification
- [ ] Extension loaded and tested in **Google Chrome** (or Chromium-based)
- [ ] Extension loaded and tested in **Mozilla Firefox**
- [ ] Verified page conversion works on different target sites
- [ ] Verified restricted/system page guards work gracefully without errors
